blocks.content: WE, THE PEOPLE OF INDIA, having solemnly resolved to constitute India into a SOVEREIGN SOCIALIST SECULAR DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC and to secure to all its citizens: JUSTICE, LIBERTY, EQUALITY and FRATERNITY.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Constitution of India is the supreme law of the country, providing the constitutional framework for governance.
Dr. B.R. Ambedkar chaired the Drafting Committee and is recognized as the chief architect of the Indian Constitution.
The Constituent Assembly completed the drafting process in 2 years, 11 months, and 18 days.
Adopted on 26th November 1949, the Constitution came into full effect on 26th January 1950, commemorated as Republic Day.
M.N. Roy first proposed the idea of a Constituent Assembly for India in 1934.
26th November is officially celebrated as Constitution Day (Samvidhan Divas) in India.
The original Constitution of India was handwritten by Prem Behari Narain Raizada.
